ns2:course.label: Interdisciplinary Approaches to Life Science
ns2:course.description: Interdisciplinary Approaches to Life Science is a multi-section Grand Challenge Learning pilot course in the Health & Wellness pathway. Each section engages specific dimensions of Health & Wellness from an interdisciplinary perspective while meeting the Gen Ed criteria for Life Science. Each section emphasizes experiential learning through, for example, projects, design-based thinking, community-engaged scholarship, or field trips. Prerequisite: Restricted to first-time new freshman or first-year transfer students.
